proposal.rationale: Stage 1 is locked; unfolding untouched. The vertical band (hough_threshold_vertical, uniform_k_snap) and SAM geometry (segment_width, K_height, angle) are left alone because ring_count_error=0 and sam_fill_rate=0.78 are already healthy and the worked example s019 shows that SAM-geometry moves can collapse fill rate. The central columns still show only 1-3 px joint fragments after binarisation, so the bottleneck is pixel survival and gap bridging, not the vote threshold alone. Step the same three knobs once more: binary_threshold 110 -> 100 (bound; example s000 used 100 with ring_count_error 0), hough_threshold_oblique 30 -> 25 (still above the ~22 used by degrade example g005, whose zeroed correspondence was joint with binary 150 and a loose vertical band, neither repeated here), maxLineGap_oblique 50 -> 60 (bound) so the dotted joint traces in the central columns can link into 5-10 deg segments, and pattern_tolerance 14 -> 16 so intersections at a second joint row can be admitted by the K/AB distance pattern and replace propagation with per-ring prompts. The oblique angle filter [5,10]/[-10,-5] deg continues to reject the 0/90 deg bolt-hole alignments, which is why round 1 produced no spurious lines. If this step yields no further gain the next round should switch to the SAM template stage rather than push detecting to its floor.
